svg.aria-label: Two recipes drawn layer by layer: the baseline uses one format everywhere, the MLP-focused recipe compresses deep MLP layers harder and keeps attention precise.
svg.text: Two recipes, drawn layer by layer
Each column is one of the 84 layers. Colour is how that part is compressed: dimmer = smaller, brighter = more precise.
every unit Q4_K, output head Q6_K
deep MLP layers Q3_K, attention Q8_0, everything else Q5_K
